commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.study_scope: Exact-source-reader fresh-input replication of joint price/allocation recovery across eight source domains, both forms, affirmation/negation and disclosed/undisclosed other-axis facts.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at q4_k_m and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Source-comparable percentage-point exact-answer accuracy difference, no-charge/available-now minus complete careful English, over 128 fresh joint price/allocation cases, two equally weighted form strata, eight source domains and the exact two source readers.
